prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel art background wall for BeastBound, a 2.5D game. Reference image is STYLE AND PALETTE ONLY: match its hand-pixeled low-resolution brown outlines, simple flat color clusters and olive green accents. Create ONLY a flat frontal barn back wall, with NO FLOOR, no ground, no straw, no characters, no props, no UI, no text, no border. Extra wide horizontal wall intended to occupy 480x72 logical game pixels. Composition fills the complete image with the wall from left to right and top to bottom, orthographic straight-on view, no perspective vanishing point. Make very simple chunky readable pixel art, restrained 12-color warm muted brown/tan palette with olive greens where applicable, broad shapes, minimal wood grain, no tiny texture noise, no photoreal lighting or gradients. Avoid detailed grain, scratches, nails, barrels, crates, hay bales, tools, lamps and miscellaneous clutter. Keep elements modest in height for the short wall strip. Simple warm muted wooden plank back wall with just a few thick upright support beams and one crossbeam. No windows, no door. Very calm and uncluttered.
